reference_solution.debt: 1800+100+20+10=1930; exclude undrawn revolving/LC amounts, ongoing hedge mark-to-market and unrestricted-subsidiary nonrecourse debt.
reference_solution.cash: 130+40+30=200 eligible; customer restriction 25 plus unrestricted-subsidiary cash 90=115 excluded. Facility-restricted cash is explicitly eligible despite its accounting label.
reference_solution.insufficiency: Section 6.10 also imposes an interest-coverage minimum. Neither Consolidated Interest Expense nor inputs to reconstruct it are supplied, so full financial-covenant compliance cannot be certified from these hypothetical values.
